examples.prompt_excerpt:
Image 1 shows the Front facade of a brick schoolhouse visible from multiple aerial viewpoints in the landmark-centric coordinate frame. Based on that reference, what is your position relative to the landmark in image 2? Select one option and return the normalized bounding box of the landmark in image 2.

Options:

A. Front
B. Left
C. Back
D. Right
examples.input_summary: a brick schoolhouse visible from multiple aerial viewpoints
